description: Sunrise, sunset and solar noon for a place and date via MET Norway. Returns sunrise, sunset, solar noon times (UTC), day length and noon elevation for a place and date. Use for daylight planning. Price $0.005 per call (x402: USDC on Base or Solana).

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (use with lon instead of place)

place.description: City or address, e.g. Berlin or 1600 Pennsylvania Ave. Not needed when lat and lon are given
